titleEn: Antrim demo hill farm turning to tech to boost output
titleZh: 安特里姆示范山区农场借助科技提升产出
summaryZh: 北爱尔兰CAFRE的Glenwherry山区农场通过虚拟围栏等新技术，在保护地面筑巢鸟类栖息地的同时，有效管理25头哺乳母牛的冬季放牧，减少了饲料和粪肥储存成本，并提升了羊群繁殖性能。该案例展示了山区农场如何在兼顾环境效益的同时提高生产效率，为智慧畜牧在复杂地形中的应用提供了实践参考。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Antrim demo hill farm turning to tech to boost output ![Image 1: Richard Halleron By Richard Halleron September 3, 2026 3:00 PM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthorrichard) Share this article ![Image 2](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsantrim-demo-hill-farm-turning-to-tech-to-boost-output) The benefits of managing hill farms proactively have been confirmed by research and development work carried out in Northern Ireland. This approach allows for balancing the food output generated by suckler cows and sheep while still maximising the environmental benefits that hill landscapes - including blanket bog - can deliver for society as a whole. Much of this research and development work is taking place at the College of Agriculture, Food and Rural Enterprise (CAFRE) hill farm, located close to the village of Glenwherry in Co. Antrim. Comprising 960ha and rising to an altitude of 1,000ft above sea level, the farm is located in the very heart of the Antrim Hills complex. The facility is also used as an important centre of education by the college. Adding to its significance is the access granted to stakeholders organisations, working in all aspects of conservation and environmental improvement. ![Image 3: Uel Agnew (left) and Steven Millar were amongst the members of the Northern Ireland Institute of Agricultural Science who recently visited the CAFRE Hill Farm at Gllenwherry in Co Antrim](https:images.agriland.ieZxgRzOnqtfzmOwSnPsWWij-pjdDCNrfhGjC2WJVUrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202609img-3435-scaled.jpg) Uel Agnew (left) and Steven Millar were amongst the members of the Northern Ireland Institute of Agricultural Science who recently visited the CAFRE Hill Farm at Gllenwherry in Co Antrim Glenwherry recently hosted a visit by members of the Northern Ireland Institute of Agricultural Science. The event was used to profile the role for new technology in managing livestock in ways that deliver from both farm output and conservation perspectives. A case in point is the application of virtual fencing systems at Glenwherry to manage the winter grazing requirements of 25 suckler cows. This approach has been taken to ensure that the spring nesting habitats of ground nesting birds, including curlew, lapwing, and snipe, are retained in optimal condition. At the heart of the fencing system are GPS collars, which can be used to direct the cows around a 74ha block of land. It is an approach that ensures the cows receive the winter grazing they require, without destroying the habitat they have access to. In addition, significant savings are secured with regard to the feeding of winter fodder while the stored slurry volumes are reduced significantly. Glenwherry Glenwherry is home to a herd of 100 suckler cows and 1,100 strong flock of breeding sheep. These animals are being used to manage the hill farm in ways that can sustain the landscape from the perspective plant species’ regeneration and water quality improvement. However, these targets are being achieved in ways that do not detract from the animal output generated on the farm. In fact, the very opposite has been the case. Recent years have seen an increase in lamb numbers, reflecting the increased performance achieved for the unit’s sheep flocks. translationZh:
在北爱尔兰进行的研究与开发工作证实了主动管理山区农场的好处。这种方法可以在平衡肉用母牛和羊生产的食物产出的同时，最大限度地发挥丘陵景观（包括泥炭沼泽）能为整个社会带来的环境效益。

这些研究与开发工作大部分正在位于安特里姆郡Glenwherry村附近的农业、食品与农村企业学院（CAFRE）山区农场进行。该农场占地960公顷，海拔高达1000英尺，位于安特里姆山区的中心地带。该设施也是学院重要的教育中心。更值得一提的是，农场还向从事自然保护和环境改善各方面工作的利益相关组织开放。

Glenwherry最近接待了北爱尔兰农业科学学会成员的访问。该活动旨在展示新技术在管理牲畜方面的作用，这些技术既能提高农场产出，又能兼顾自然保护。

一个典型的例子是在Glenwherry应用虚拟围栏系统来管理25头哺乳母牛的冬季放牧需求。采用这种方法是为了确保地面筑巢鸟类（包括杓鹬、田鹬和沙锥）的春季筑巢栖息地保持最佳状态。该围栏系统的核心是GPS项圈，可用于引导母牛在74公顷的土地上活动。这种方法既能确保母牛获得所需的冬季放牧，又不会破坏它们所接触的栖息地。此外，还能显著节省冬季饲料的投入，同时大幅减少储存的粪肥量。

Glenwherry饲养着100头哺乳母牛和1100只繁殖母羊。这些动物被用来管理山区农场，以维持植物物种再生和水质改善方面的景观可持续性。然而，这些目标的实现并没有影响农场的动物产出。事实上，情况恰恰相反。近年来，羔羊数量有所增加，反映出该单位羊群的生产性能得到了提升。
